integrity: The face census, mod-two homology, integral order-two certificate, automorphism group, vertex orbits, and all five shortest-cycle orbits are recomputed exhaustively from the exact facet list. Prior literature is used for exact-object provenance, minimality, and comparison, not as a substitute for the new finite checks.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns Walkup's unique vertex- and facet-minimal eleven-vertex triangulation of real projective three-space and combinatorial unit-edge length. It does not classify the other twenty-nine eleven-vertex triangulations, longer simple representatives, or geometric metric systoles.
title: Fifty-five triangular torsion systoles in the minimal eleven-vertex real projective 3-space
